WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW6-140BLK66-0260'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, bom.qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CRO-795-OAK-02052'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the bundle SKU
bundle AS (
    SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-US-0160'
),
-- 2. Item SKUs in the bundle
items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
),
-- 3. Models for each item SKU
item_models AS (
    SELECT i.item_sku_id, i.bundle_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM items i
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = i.item_sku_id
),
-- 4. Model BOM edges (current)
model_edges AS (
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- 5. Component BOM edges (current)
comp_edges AS (
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- 6. Recursive expansion from each model
expansion AS (
    -- base: model -> component
    SELECT im.item_sku_id, im.bundle_qty, im.model_qty,
           me.component_id AS component_id,
           CAST(me.qty AS DOUBLE) AS path_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_edges me ON me.model_id = im.model_id
    UNION ALL
    -- recursive: assembly -> child
    SELECT e.item_sku_id, e.bundle_qty, e.model_qty,
           ce.child_component_id,
           e.path_qty * ce.qty
    FROM expansion e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN comp_edges ce ON ce.parent_component_id = e.component_id
),
-- 7. Sum quantities for the target part
target AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'FOO-834-BLK-01870'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.bundle_qty * e.model_qty * e.path_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM expansion e
JOIN target t ON t.component_id = e.component_id;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Resolve bundle to its item SKUs (current bundle composition is not date-versioned)
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE s.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0329'
),
-- Item SKUs -> company models
item_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, sm.qty AS sku_model_qty, bi.bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Model BOM edges valid as of 2026-10-01
model_edges AS (
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Component BOM edges valid as of 2026-10-01
comp_edges AS (
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive explosion: start from each model's direct components
explosion AS (
    SELECT
        im.model_id,
        me.component_id,
        CAST(im.bundle_qty * im.sku_model_qty * me.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_edges me ON me.model_id = im.model_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        e.model_id,
        ce.child_component_id,
        e.qty * ce.qty
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN comp_edges ce ON ce.parent_component_id = e.component_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explosion e
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CON-328-BLK-00970'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Explode each order line down to components, using BOM valid on order date
explode AS (
    -- Base: model BOM for non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        o.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Base: bundle SKUs -> item SKUs -> models
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        o.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(bi.qty * sm.qty * mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = item.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: assembly component BOM
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.order_qty,
        e.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id,
        e.qty_per_unit * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM explode e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(e.order_qty * e.qty_per_unit), 0) AS total_units
FROM explode e

JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = e.order_id
JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id

WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS ancestor_id,
        1.0 AS qty_per_ancestor
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-834-BLK-01870'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.component_id,
        cb.parent_component_id AS ancestor_id,
        pt.qty_per_ancestor * cb.qty AS qty_per_ancestor
    FROM part_tree pt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.child_component_id = pt.ancestor_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all components (assemblies) that contain the part, with total qty per assembly
assembly_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        ancestor_id AS assembly_id,
        SUM(qty_per_ancestor) AS part_qty_per_assembly
    FROM part_tree
    WHERE ancestor_id != component_id
    GROUP BY ancestor_id
),
-- Expand bundle to item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0160'
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Map models to assemblies (components with is_assembly = true)
model_assemblies AS (
    SELECT 
        im.item_qty,
        im.model_qty,
        mb.component_id AS assembly_id,
        mb.qty AS assembly_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = im.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
)
-- Calculate total part quantity in one bundle
SELECT SUM(ma.item_qty * ma.model_qty * ma.assembly_qty * aq.part_qty_per_assembly) AS total_part_qty
FROM model_assemblies ma
JOIN assembly_quantities aq ON aq.assembly_id = ma.assembly_id;

-- Get all item SKUs in the bundle with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.sku_code = 'BDL-JP-0096'
),

-- Get models for each item SKU (non-bundle SKUs map to models)
item_models AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.bundle_item_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get top-level components from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT im.bundle_item_qty, im.model_qty, mb.component_id, mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs
exploded_components AS (
    -- Base: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.bundle_item_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.bom_qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        ec.bundle_item_qty,
        ec.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        ec.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM exploded_components ec
    JOIN component c ON ec.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ec.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cb.valid_to)
)

    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'GEA-767-OAK-00892'
),
-- Get current date for BOM validity

    SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS d
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs from assemblies down to parts
component_explosion AS (
    -- Base: direct children of assemblies in current BOM
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS root_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_bom cb, current_date cd
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies further
    SELECT 
        ce.root_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        ce.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component c ON ce.component_id = c.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Find all assemblies (including the part itself if it's used directly) that contain the target part
assemblies_with_part AS (
    -- The part itself if referenced directly in model_bom
    SELECT tp.component_id AS assembly_id
    FROM target_part tp
    
    UNION
    
    -- All assemblies that contain the target part at any level
    SELECT ce.root_assembly_id AS assembly_id
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN target_part tp ON ce.component_id = tp.component_id
),
-- Find all models that use any of these assemblies/parts in their current BOM

    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cd.d)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the component_id for the part LEG-116-OAK-01977
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'LEG-116-OAK-01977'
),
-- Get all model BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all component BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive expansion: starting from models, explode through component BOMs
-- We track (model_id, component_at_this_level, cumulative_qty_from_model_to_here)
model_components AS (
    -- Base: direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        m.model_id,
        m.component_id AS current_component_id,
        m.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_model_bom m
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS current_component_id,
        mc.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.current_component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN current_component_bom cb ON mc.current_component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
),
-- Find all models that contain the target part at any level
models_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT model_id
    FROM model_components
    WHERE current_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
),
-- Also need to check if target part is directly in model BOM (not through assembly)
models_with_direct_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT model_id
    FROM current_model_bom
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
),
-- All models that contain the part
all_models_with_part AS (
    SELECT model_id FROM models_with_part
    UNION
    SELECT model_id FROM models_with_direct_part
),
-- Find non-bundle SKUs that map to these models
skus_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN all_models_with_part mp ON sm.model_id = mp.model_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skus_with_part

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as sku_model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER9-140WHT90-0769'
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.qty as bundle_item_qty,
        sm.qty as sku_model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER9-140WHT90-0769'
),
-- All SKUs that contribute to this model, with their multipliers
all_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs: multiplier is the sku_model qty
    SELECT sku_id, sku_model_qty as multiplier FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    -- Bundle SKUs: multiplier is bundle_item_qty * sku_model_qty
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, bundle_item_qty * sku_model_qty as multiplier FROM bundle_skus
),
-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, s.multiplier
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_skus s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total units sold
units_sold AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * rl.multiplier), 0) as total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT total_units FROM units_sold

-- First, get all orders in CA in 2024 with completed status
ca_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU quantities
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
),

-- Calculate total quantity sold per SKU (including through bundles)
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to expand to item SKUs
-- For non-bundle SKUs, we use directly
sku_sales AS (
    -- Direct sales of non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        osq.sku_id,
        SUM(osq.line_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    GROUP BY osq.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle sales: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        SUM(osq.line_qty * bi.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
    GROUP BY bi.item_sku_id
),

-- Aggregate total quantity per SKU (in case a SKU appears both directly and in bundles)
total_sku_sales AS (
    SELECT sku_id, SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM sku_sales
    GROUP BY sku_id
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(tss.total_qty * sm.qty) AS model_total_qty
    FROM total_sku_sales tss
    JOIN sku_model sm ON tss.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
)

-- Get top 3 models
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM sku_model_qty smq
JOIN company_model cm ON smq.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY smq.model_total_qty DESC
LIMIT 3
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the component_id for the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'FAS-359-GRY-00889'
),

-- Get store_id for Wayfair-DE-11
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id 
    FROM store 
    WHERE store_name = 'Wayfair-DE-11'
),

-- Get all completed orders for the target store in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN order_line ol ON so.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Resolve bundles to item SKUs with quantities
resolved_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id AS final_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS final_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.order_id,
        rs.order_date,
        rs.final_sku_id,
        rs.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        rs.sku_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM resolved_skus rs
    JOIN sku_model sm ON rs.final_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOM
component_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: start with models and their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.total_model_qty AS parent_qty,
        mb.component_id AS child_component_id,
        mb.qty AS child_qty_per_parent,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        ch.order_id,
        ch.order_date,
        ch.total_qty AS parent_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty AS child_qty_per_parent,
        ch.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_hierarchy ch
    JOIN component c ON ch.child_component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= ch.order_date
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ch.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up total consumption of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ch.total_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM component_hierarchy ch
JOIN target_part tp ON ch.child_component_id = tp.component_id
JOIN component c ON ch.child_component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false;
```

    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id

    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        osl.sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osl.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their items
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osl.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to components
model_bom_recursive AS (
    -- Base: direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT

        mbr.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mbr.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        mbr.order_date,
        mbr.level + 1
    FROM model_bom_recursive mbr
    JOIN component c ON mbr.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true

)

    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Walmart-UK-22'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_sku_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.is_bundle,
        sk.sku_code,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs pass through directly
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        osl.sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty as sku_qty  -- quantity of this SKU in the order
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: multiply by bundle item qty
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON osl.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.sku_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty,
        sm.model_id
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Now explode through model BOM to components
model_bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        1 as level
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components through component BOM
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        mbe.level + 1
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- Get only leaf parts (non-assembly components)
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.total_qty,
        mbe.component_id
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
),

-- Sum up by component
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        lp.component_id,
        SUM(lp.total_qty) as total_consumed
    FROM leaf_parts lp
    GROUP BY lp.component_id
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pc.total_consumed), 0) as units_consumed
FROM part_consumption pc
JOIN component c ON pc.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-140-GRY-02859';

WITH RECURSIVE model_component AS (
    -- Get the model_id for SW2-120GRY39-0330
    SELECT cm.model_id
    FROM company_model cm
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW2-120GRY39-0330'
),
model_bom_expanded AS (
    -- Start with direct components from model BOM valid on 2025-03-12
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN model_component mc ON mb.model_id = mc.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2025-03-12'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-03-12' <= mb.valid_to)
),
component_tree AS (
    -- Base case: start with model BOM components
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        mbe.total_qty
    FROM model_bom_expanded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies through component BOM
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        ct.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM component_tree ct
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ct.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ct.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= '2025-03-12'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-03-12' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_qty * unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM component_tree
WHERE is_assembly = false;

    JOIN ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id

-- For bundles: parent is bundle SKU, child is item SKU

        ve.child_code AS model_code,
        osq.line_qty * ve.qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN valid_edges ve ON osq.sku_code = ve.parent_code 
        AND ve.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ve.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case for bundle items: direct item SKU -> model edges
    -- (bundle SKUs don't map directly to models)
    SELECT 
        osq.sku_code AS root_sku,
        osq.line_qty AS root_qty,
        ve.child_code AS model_code,

    JOIN valid_edges ve ON osq.sku_code = ve.parent_code

    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN valid_edges ve ON osq.sku_code = ve.parent_code 
        AND ve.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ve.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = true

    SELECT 
        sm.root_sku,
        sm.root_qty,
        ve.child_code AS current_code,
        sm.accumulated_qty * ve.qty AS accumulated_qty
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN valid_edges ve ON sm.current_code = ve.parent_code
